Owners seeking affiliation **without imposing a highly standardized identity** generally consider **soft brands**, also called **collection brands**. These provide distribution, loyalty-program access, technology and sales support while allowing the property to retain much of its existing name, design and local character.

### Commonly considered soft brands

| Parent company | Collection brands frequently evaluated |
|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, **The Luxury Collection**—Marriott specifically positions these as collection brands for independent hotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection**, **Tapestry Collection**, and, at the luxury level, **LXR Hotels & Resorts**. Curio and Tapestry use flexible frameworks intended to preserve each hotel’s story and character. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection**, **JdV by Hyatt**, and **Destination by Hyatt**; the newer **Unscripted by Hyatt** offers an especially conversion-friendly upscale option. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection** for luxury hotels and the newer **Noted Collection** in the premium segment. Both emphasize maintaining the property’s identity while accessing IHG’s commercial platform. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice Hotels** | **Ascend Hotel Collection**, commonly considered by independent upscale and boutique owners seeking more operating and design freedom. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Trademark Collection** for upper-midscale-and-above hotels, **Registry Collection** for luxury properties, and **Dazzler Select** for more value-oriented independent hotels. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/brand/trademark-collection-by-wyndham/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels** | **BW Premier Collection**, **BW Signature Collection**, and the various **WorldHotels** collections. These are designed around independent operation and distinctive property character. ([development.bwhhotels.com](https://development.bwhhotels.com/content/developers/en_US/portfolio.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Handwritten Collection**, **MGallery**, and **Emblems Collection**, spanning midscale through luxury and structured to preserve a hotel’s original character. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/collection-brands-handwritten-emblems-mgallery?utm_source=openai)) |

### Typical first-round shortlist by positioning

- **Luxury:** Luxury Collection, LXR, Vignette, Unbound, Emblems, Registry or WorldHotels Luxury  
- **Upper-upscale/upscale boutique:** Autograph, Curio, Tribute, Tapestry, JdV, Ascend, MGallery or BW Premier Collection  
- **Upper-midscale or conversion-focused:** Trademark, BW Signature Collection, Handwritten, Unscripted or Dazzler Select  

“Soft” does not mean unrestricted. Owners still need to compare **property-improvement requirements, reservation and loyalty fees, mandatory systems, design approval, operating standards, territorial protection, agreement length and termination rights**. The amount of genuine independence can differ substantially even among collection brands.
